data.details: (Q1 Un-audited): EPS was Tk. 3.17 for July-September 2026 as against Tk. 2.26 for July-September 2025. NOCFPS was Tk. 5.19 for July-September 2026 as against Tk. 3.67 for July-September 2025. NAV per share was Tk. 63.49 as on September 30, 2026 and Tk. 60.33 as on June 30, 2026.

As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on November 08, 2026 at 3:00 PM to consider, among others, Un-Audited Financial Statements for the First Quarter (Q1) period ended September 30, 2026.
Trading of the shares of the company will resume on 27-Oct-2026.
data.bn: 27 অক্টোবর 2026 কোম্পানির শেয়ারের লেনদেন পুনরায় শুরু হবে।
data.summary_en: Trading in the company’s shares will resume on October 27, 2026.
